name: Workflow regression check
description: A starter eval to compare workflow output against a known expected result.

payload.name: Workflow regression check
payload.description: Use a repeatable expected output to compare workflow results over time.

experiment.input: Run the workflow and inspect the final output.
experiment.expectedOutput: expected workflow output with required handoff and completion markers
experiment.judgeGuidance: Require every explicit completion marker and handoff field. Report each missing or mismatched value without inferring intent.

input.value: Run the workflow and inspect the final output.

expected.value: expected workflow output with required handoff and completion markers
